question.en: Discuss the role of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) in promoting global economic development and its significance for India.

introduction.en: The IBRD, established in 1944, is the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group. It was created to facilitate post-war reconstruction and has evolved into a global development institution.
introduction.hi: The IBRD, established in 1944, is the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group. It was created to facilitate post-war reconstruction and has evolved into a global development institution.

body.en: IBRD provides loans, guarantees, and technical assistance to middle-income countries. It operates by raising funds in capital markets, ensuring financial sustainability. For India, IBRD has been crucial in financing large-scale projects in energy, transport, and human capital development, supporting India's transition to a higher growth trajectory.

conclusion.en: IBRD remains a vital partner for India, helping address structural bottlenecks and promoting sustainable development goals.

valueAddition.en: IBRD maintains a AAA credit rating, allowing it to provide low-cost financing to developing nations.
